name: High-Volume Push / Pull / Legs
description: Six long workouts a week for 12 weeks, push, pull and legs twice, 10 or 11 exercises and 33 to 43 sets a day, for experienced lifters who recover well. The A days open with a reverse pyramid on a main lift (heaviest set first, then two lighter sets of more reps); the B days open with a top set and three back-off sets. Week 6 is a deload; the second block is heavier with fewer reps. Cut sets before cutting sleep or food: if the weights stall for two weeks, take the deload early.

phases.name: Volume
phases.description: Reverse pyramid of 6 to 12 reps on the A days, top set of 5 or 6 and back-off sets of 8 to 10 on the B days

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy

phases.name: Intensity
phases.description: Reverse pyramid of 4 to 10 reps, top set of 3 to 5 and back-off sets of 6 to 8

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy
